extracted_decision.summary: Mechanical permission-layer lock: executor agents can never run git add/checkout/commit/push via bash (deny in repo + global opencode.json); all git writes go through the stage/commit MCP tools; git mv stays allowed for Kanban moves.
extracted_decision.rationale: Prompt-only ZAC claims failed open; explicit deny rules are enforced even in auto mode.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Top-level deny binds every agent in these configs, not just the executor; bare + wildcard patterns both listed.
